scope: Claim-level clonal propagation, mother-stock, rooting, sanitation, quarantine, tissue-culture, acclimatization, genetic-stability, and germplasm-preservation evidence for THC-ENC-161 through THC-ENC-180.
rules: Cannabis-specific propagation and tissue-culture results remain bounded to tested genotypes, donor condition, media, environment, treatment range, passage history, and methods.
General plant rooting or sanitation sources support mechanisms and workflow boundaries only; they do not establish universal cannabis recipes.
Pesticide, disinfectant, plant-regulator, worker-safety, and laboratory claims remain controlled by current labels, registrations, jurisdiction, and method-specific instructions.
All mappings remain pending independent science review and do not alter lesson publication or independent-approval state.
